text:
Elyse: Quick sync — three pilots asked for per-route reserved capacity + a flexible softcap they can burst into. Need to decide if this is an 'addon' (throughput SKU) or a tier change. Thoughts?

Mateo: My quick take: treat as addon if we can cap cost and isolate scheduling. Tier change if it needs different SLA + guaranteed tokens.

Priya: Sales says customers want predictable commit and a small buffer for spikes. Also asking for a rollback clause in contracts. We should outline launch criteria: pricing, SLA, and legal carveouts.

Omar: Infra note: per-route reservations implies routing + allocation changes. We need a spike estimate: memory for KV cache + extra slots. I can run a capacity spike but need a clear spec.

Hannah: To add color from pilots — two are willing to pay +1 for burst buffer, third prefers committing to a higher tier. All ask is low friction to switch on/off.

Priya: Risk: if we call it an addon, ops must support mixed tenancy on pools, may increase fragmentation. If tier, commercial negotiation is heavier but simpler runtime.

Mateo: Proposal: prototype as an "elastic throughput addon" with these gating conditions: p99 latency delta <= 20% in bursts, clear unit price (per reserved route token), and an opt-out rollback within 30 days. If tests fail, escalate to tier plan.

Elyse: Love that. Can we make a concrete launch checklist?

Mateo: ```
Launch checklist (initial):
- Spec: addon semantics and API (toggle, token amount)
- Cost model: per-token price + overage pricing
- Infra spike test: simulated 10x burst across 100 routes
- SLA: p50/p95/p99 targets + degradation policy
- Legal: contract clause template for rollback/credits
- UX: enable/disable + billing surface in console
- Docs & SDK examples
```

Omar: I can do the infra spike if Priya/Mateo give me token semantics. Est: 5 dev-days + 2 perf-days.

LegalBot: Flag: if we allow on-demand burst across customer routes, add explicit limits to liability and a clear definition of "burst misuse". Need Product + Legal to approve wording.

Hannah: Sales asks us to prioritize a small self-serve pilot toggle for 2 customers first (low-touch). That would validate UX and billing.

Elyse: Decision for today: prototype as an addon, run infra spike, draft pricing + contract language. If spike shows unacceptable perf variance, re-evaluate as tier change. Action owners: Mateo (spec & pricing), Omar (infra spike), Priya (pilot coordination & legal liaison), Hannah (customer pilot). Target: internal RFC by next Tue (1757600000).

Mateo: I'll draft the RFC and include a simple cost model.

Priya: I'll schedule pilot kickoff with the two willing customers and loop Legal for clause drafts.

Omar: Starting spike on Monday. Tag me for sample traffic profiles.

Elyse: Thanks all. Adding follow-up: make the console toggle have a single-click disable for immediate rollback and a billing preview modal. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy queued for infra-sim branch (ci/elastic-addon-spike) — ETA 02:00 UTC.
